business_problem: Global Payments Solutions employees needed too long to answer complex client product and onboarding questions because knowledge was spread across internal materials and often required calls with product specialists in different regions and time zones.
solution_summary: Bank of America built Ask Global Payments Solutions (AskGPS) in-house as a generative AI assistant for its Global Payments Solutions organization. The implementation is centered on a curated internal knowledge corpus: over 3,200 internal documents and presentations, including product guides, term sheets, and FAQs, are used to train the assistant and turn static reference content into a real-time question-answering system. Employees can submit simple or complex client questions and receive responses within seconds, rather than manually searching documents or contacting regional product specialists. The assistant serves salespeople and bankers by surfacing vetted answers, best practices, and precedents across sectors and geographies to support product, onboarding, and advisory conversations. The source does not name an external model provider, storage platform, or orchestration stack, so the disclosed architecture is limited to the in-house GenAI application layer and its internal document corpus.
